name: Auto repair estimate reference ranges (SAMPLE)
scope: SAMPLE dataset: national average ranges for common jobs, not a quote for any specific vehicle. Actual cost depends on year/make/model, region, and the shop's labor rate. The full repair-manual dataset (Mitchell / ALLDATA labor times and OEM parts catalogs) is proprietary and is NOT included; a shop replaces this file with its own price book. Ranges below are the values the estimate engine returns, verbatim, with this source cited in every response.
source: RepairPal Fair Price Estimator, September 2026 (national average cost, parts + labor), as summarized by Zarla, November 2026 (https://www.zarla.com/guides/how-much-do-mechanics-charge-per-hour). Pads + rotors row: CostFlock 2026 compilation of RepairPal / ConsumerAffairs / Tekmetric (https://costflock.com/auto/brake-replacement-cost/).
